posts.title:
Do you need
[a handcuff?]
posts.lead: A handcuff is your starting running back's backup. Here's when one is worth the bench spot:
bullets: Losing him would end your season
The backup gets the whole job
Not a committee where he'd split carries
Don't cut a real starter to hold one

caption.instagram:
Do you need a handcuff? 🔗

A handcuff is your starting RB's backup. It's worth the bench spot when:
1️⃣ Your RB1 carries your team
2️⃣ The backup would get the whole job, not a split
3️⃣ Your bench can spare it

Handcuff or no handcuff? 👇

#fantasyfootball #fantasyfootballadvice #handcuff #allfantasy
